curve_method: Kaplan–Meier descriptive curves. Unrecovered transitions are censored at the next change/end; phase durations vary. Censoring independence is an assumption, so read curves with observed recovery fractions and capped costs.
diagnostic_scope: All completed conditions, with no test-selected filtering. Library imports describe the final most-probable program, not every provisional candidate. Noise-shift tasks use their declared changing noise schedule instead of the nominal noise column.
findings: On relays with successive new rules, the new EPIG/change learner recovered on 89/144 changes, versus 111/144 for broad-upfront. Mean capped recovery cost was 69.4 versus 66.1 answers; failures retain their available horizon.

On relays with a returning rule, the new EPIG/change learner recovered on 83/144 changes, versus 97/144 for broad-upfront. Mean capped recovery cost was 69.1 versus 63.8 answers; failures retain their available horizon.

After the first 32 answers on random-coin tasks, the new learner's probability error (Brier) was 0.301, versus 0.460; 0.250 is optimal for a fair coin. It assigned at least 90% confidence to 6.7% of predictions, versus 83.0%.
The library produced 422 concept records across repeated independent runs; 0 passed the two-task predictive gate. These are records, not globally distinct concepts.

On new pair tasks, the validated library changed mean accuracy during learning from 96.3% to 96.3%. Total capped answers to success, including acquisition, were 871.2 versus 871.2; total search costs were 1415613 versus 1415613 program–scene evaluations.

On new relay tasks, the validated library changed mean accuracy during learning from 71.5% to 71.5%. Total capped answers to success, including acquisition, were 989.4 versus 989.4; total search costs were 1500107 versus 1500107 program–scene evaluations.
query_coverage_scope: Post-hoc descriptive diagnostic added after inspecting the complete core results. It measures public teaching-graph size and distinct questions for every relay condition. Four objects is the largest permitted teaching graph, including broken chains; it is not a label of a successful three-link path. These associations do not establish why a policy generalizes better or worse. No experiment settings were changed.
